purpose: Teach: 代物/承っ/施さ/組み立てる/忘れ物/目指せ/習う/参観

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新商品、ちょっと普通じゃない代物だね。
lines.en: This new product is pretty unconventional, isn't it.
lines.style: Clear-eyed assessment. Even pace, matter-of-fact delivery. A shared observation between colleagues—not criticism, just noticing what's in front of them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先週、注文、多数承っています。
lines.en: It is. We picked up quite a few orders just last week.
lines.style: Straightforward confirmation. Warm, engaged. Voice carries a note of quiet satisfaction—the weight of those orders landing is real.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 特別な処理を施さないと、部品の品質、向上しない。
lines.en: We'll need special treatment on the parts, otherwise the quality won't improve the way it should.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. Speaking as someone who's thought this through. Not urgent, but attentive—each phrase lands with intention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。部品を組み立てる作業、効率化中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're streamlining the assembly process right now.
lines.style: Reporting in with quiet momentum. Voice has a forward tilt—things are moving. Not rushed, but efficient.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 発送時、忘れ物がないか、確認しよう。
lines.en: When we ship, let's make sure nothing gets missed in the details.
lines.style: Calm directive. A gentle hand on the wheel. Not commanding—inviting Kenji into shared responsibility with 'let's.' Warm but precise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 目指せ業界トップ、社員に共有しました。
lines.en: I've already shared the goal with the team—we're aiming to lead the industry.
lines.style: Confident and assured. Voice carries the momentum of something already set in motion. A small lift at the end—this is real.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人、職人技を習う制度、強化しよう。
lines.en: We should strengthen the mentorship program for new hires so they can really learn the craft.
lines.style: Thoughtful and forward-looking. Speaking as an architect, not a commander. Slow enough for the words to settle—this matters for the team's future.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外バイヤー、参観の予約、入りました。
lines.en: Yes. We already have overseas buyers scheduled to come observe the process.
lines.style: Finishing strong. Slightly quickened pace—the news carries weight. Proud, grounded. Voice lands firm on the last phrase.
